about_short_description.short_description: June is a smart oven for your home that makes cooking perfectly easy.

product.name: June Oven
product.description: A 12-in-1 countertop smart oven that combines multiple cooking functions including convection oven, air fryer, grill, roaster, slow cooker, dehydrator, toaster, broiler, warming drawer, pizza oven, and proofer.

product.name: June App
product.description: A mobile application for iOS and Android that connects to the June Oven, providing remote control, cooking progress tracking, live camera feed, temperature graphs, time-lapse videos, and access to guided smart recipes.

product.name: Food ID Technology
product.description: An internal system using an HD camera and on-device network to recognize food items placed inside the June Oven and automatically configure optimal cooking programs.

product.name: Virtual Rotisserie
product.description: A cooking mode in the June Oven that uses individual control of six heating elements to simulate rotisserie-style cooking without physical rotation mechanisms.

product.name: Auto Alerts
product.description: A notification system that alerts users when cooking is nearly complete and when food is perfectly cooked, based on internal food temperature rather than timers.

product.name: HD Camera
product.description: A built-in wide-angle high-definition camera inside the June Oven that captures live footage and time-lapse videos of cooking sessions, and supports Food ID recognition.
